senses.title: Prevalence versus incidence
senses.titleCN: 患病率与发病率之分
senses.definition: the stock of existing cases, contrasted with incidence, the flow of new cases
senses.definitionCN: 现有病例的存量，与发病率所指的新增病例流量相对
senses.example: Prevalence stays high even when incidence falls, because patients live longer.
senses.exampleCN: 即使发病率下降，患病率仍可能很高，因为病人活得更久。
senses.why: The stock-and-flow distinction is the core of epidemiology. Prevalence counts all who have it; incidence counts all who get it.
senses.whyCN: 存量与流量之分是流行病学的核心。患病率统计所有正患病者，发病率统计所有新患病者。

senses.title: Prevalence rate
senses.titleCN: 患病率数值：比例、分母
senses.definition: the numerical ratio of cases to the whole population, often expressed per hundred thousand
senses.definitionCN: 病例与总人口之比，常以每十万人计
senses.example: Prevalence rates are hard to compare across countries with different testing.
senses.exampleCN: 检测水平不同的国家之间，患病率很难比较。
senses.why: A rate needs a denominator. The word supplies the idea of proportion, and the phrase supplies the arithmetic.
senses.whyCN: 比率需要分母。这个词提供比例的概念，短语提供算术。

senses.title: Prevalence of an idea
senses.titleCN: 观念或做法的流行
senses.definition: the extent to which a belief, custom or practice is found among people
senses.definitionCN: 某种观念、习俗或做法在人群中被发现的程度
senses.example: The prevalence of the custom surprised the visiting researchers.
senses.exampleCN: 这一习俗的普遍程度让来访研究者感到意外。
senses.why: Social science borrows the medical word: beliefs spread and persist like infections, so the same measure applies.
senses.whyCN: 社会科学借用医学词：观念像感染一样传播与留存，因此可用同一度量。

senses.title: Point versus period
senses.titleCN: 时点与时期：两个窗口
senses.definition: in epidemiology, the contrast between prevalence measured at one moment and over a stated period
senses.definitionCN: 流行病学中在某一瞬间测量与在某一时期内测量的对照
senses.example: Point prevalence counts cases on the day of the survey.
senses.exampleCN: 时点患病率统计调查当天的病例。
senses.why: The window defines the count. A snapshot and a season give different numbers from the same population.
senses.whyCN: 窗口定义计数。快照与一整季，从同一人群得到不同数字。

senses.title: Statistical proportion
senses.titleCN: 统计比例：总体中的占比
senses.definition: the fraction of a defined population showing a characteristic at a stated time
senses.definitionCN: 在指定时间，某一界定人群中具备某特征的比例
senses.example: Prevalence is a proportion, so it always lies between zero and one.
senses.exampleCN: 患病率是比例，所以总在零与一之间。
senses.why: Statistics reduces the word to a proportion with a clear numerator and denominator, which is why it can be plotted and compared.
senses.whyCN: 统计学把词化简为有明确分子分母的比例，因此它能被画图与比较。

senses.title: Prevalence in public debate
senses.titleCN: 公共讨论中的“有多普遍”
senses.definition: used in policy argument to claim that a problem is common and therefore demands action
senses.definitionCN: 在政策论证中用来声称某问题很普遍，因而需要行动
senses.example: The prevalence of food insecurity was used to justify the new programme.
senses.exampleCN: 粮食不安全问题的普遍性被用来为新计划辩护。
senses.why: Numbers persuade. Calling a problem prevalent does rhetorical work beyond describing frequency.
senses.whyCN: 数字有说服力。把问题称为“普遍”，除了描述频率，还有修辞作用。

intro.en: Prevalence comes from Latin praevalere 'to be stronger, prevail', from prae- 'before, beyond' plus valere 'to be strong'. The noun is praevalentia.
intro.cn: prevalence 来自拉丁 praevalere“更强、占优势”，由 prae-“在前、超过”加 valere“强壮”构成，名词为 praevalentia。

items.en: valere meant 'to be strong, be well, be worth'. It gives value, valid and valour, all built on strength or worth.
items.cn: valere 意为“强壮、健康、有价值”。它产出 value、valid、valour，都建立在“力量”或“价值”上。

items.en: prae- 'before, beyond' plus valere produced praevalere, 'to be stronger than, prevail'. The prefix marks superiority, not time alone.
items.cn: prae-“在前、超过”加 valere 构成 praevalere“强过、占优势”。前缀标记优势，不只是时间。

items.en: The abstract noun praevalentia named superior force or wide influence. Late Latin used it for what holds sway.
items.cn: 抽象名词 praevalentia 指优势力量或广泛影响。晚期拉丁语用它指“占主导地位者”。

items.en: English borrows prevalence in the 1600s for the quality of being widespread or dominant.
items.cn: 英语在 17 世纪借入 prevalence，指“普遍存在或占优势”的性质。

items.en: In the 19th and 20th centuries public health fixes the technical sense: the proportion of a population with a condition.
items.cn: 19 至 20 世纪，公共卫生固定了技术义：人群中患某状况的比例。

items.en: Sociology and economics extend it to beliefs and behaviours, where spread can be measured the same way.
items.cn: 社会学与经济学把它扩展到观念与行为，其扩散可用同样方式测量。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the val- stem or the pre- prefix; the near-meaning group all concern how common something is, differing in measurement.
note.cn: 形近组共享 val- 词干或 pre- 前缀；近义组都关心“有多常见”，差别在度量方式。

entries.definition: widespread or dominant. The adjective describes the thing; prevalence names the fact or the rate.
entries.definitionCN: 普遍的；流行的。形容词描述事物，prevalence 命名事实或比率。

entries.definition: to be widespread, or to win out. It names the holding of ground that prevalence then measures.
entries.definitionCN: 盛行；占优势。它命名占据优势的过程，prevalence 则度量它。

entries.definition: sound or legally effective. It comes from valere 'be strong' but means 'having force', not 'being common'.
entries.definitionCN: 有效的；正当的。同出 valere“强壮”，但意为“有力量”，不是“普遍”。

entries.definition: the rate at which new cases appear in a period. It measures flow, while prevalence measures stock.
entries.definitionCN: 发病率。它度量新病例的流量，而 prevalence 度量存量。

entries.definition: the rate of occurrence of events. It counts repetitions, while prevalence counts how many are affected.
entries.definitionCN: 频率。它统计事件重复次数，而 prevalence 统计受影响的人数比例。

entries.definition: the quality of occurring often. It is the everyday equivalent, without the technical denominator.
entries.definitionCN: 常见性。它是日常说法，没有技术上的分母。

entries.definition: the state of being most powerful or influential. It stresses control, where prevalence stresses spread.
entries.definitionCN: 支配地位。它强调控制力，而 prevalence 强调扩散范围。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词。

normal.en: valere 'be strong' plus pre- 'beyond' gives 'strong enough to hold everywhere', hence 'widespread'.
normal.cn: valere“强壮”加 pre-“超过”，得“强到处处站得住”，即“普遍”。

normal.en: Prevalence is a stock; incidence is a flow. The bathtub picture makes the difference concrete.
normal.cn: 患病率是存量，发病率是流量。浴缸的比喻让差别变得具体。

normal.en: The adjective prevalent is the everyday form: a prevalent belief is one that prevails.
normal.cn: 形容词 prevalent 是日常形式：“流行的看法”就是占上风的观念。

normal.en: Prevalence rate always has a denominator, which is why the phrase appears in every epidemiology paper.
normal.cn: 患病率总有分母，所以这个短语出现在每篇流行病学论文里。

normal.en: Point prevalence and period prevalence differ only in the time window used for counting.
normal.cn: 时点患病率与时期患病率只差在计数所用的时间窗口。

abstract.en: Picture a stain spreading across paper until most of the sheet is coloured.
abstract.cn: 想象一片污渍在纸上扩散，直到大部分纸面都被染上颜色。

abstract.en: Picture a bathtub: the water level is prevalence, the tap is incidence, the drain is recovery.
abstract.cn: 想象一个浴缸：水位是患病率，水龙头是发病率，排水口是康复。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd where every tenth person wears the same hat.
abstract.cn: 想象人群里每十个人就有一个人戴同样的帽子。

examples.en: The prevalence of smoking has fallen among teenagers.
examples.cn: 青少年吸烟的普遍程度已经下降。

examples.en: Prevalence counts everyone who has the condition, not only new cases.
examples.cn: 患病率统计所有正患该病的人，而不只是新病例。

examples.en: Researchers compared the prevalence of the habit across four regions.
examples.cn: 研究者比较了这一习惯在四个地区的流行程度。

dict_mnemonic.text: “普瑞沃伦斯”音近 prevalence：普普通通的东西“沃”得到处都是、连成一片——遍地都有 → prevalence 普遍存在

root: 拉丁 prae-“在前、超过”+ valere“强壮”→ praevalere“占优势”；praevalentia 词干 + -ence 名词后缀。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all ask how much of something is present in a frame, and the differences come from the frame and the arithmetic.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在问“某个框里有多少这种东西”，差别在框与算法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one colour spreading until it covers the map.
core.cn: 核心意象：一种颜色扩散到几乎盖满地图。

branches.en: SPREAD: phones and customs are both measured by how widely they are found.
branches.cn: 扩散：手机与习俗都按“分布多广”来衡量。

branches.en: STOCK AND FLOW: prevalence counts existing cases, incidence counts new ones, and the two answer different questions.
branches.cn: 存量与流量：患病率数现有病例，发病率数新病例，回答不同问题。

branches.en: ARITHMETIC: a rate and a proportion are the same fraction seen as a number or as a share.
branches.cn: 算术：比率与比例是同一个分数，一个看成数值，一个看成占比。

branches.en: WINDOWS: point and period prevalence differ only in when the counting happens.
branches.cn: 窗口：时点与时期患病率只差在计数的时间。

branches.en: PERSUASION: calling a problem prevalent turns a frequency into an argument for action.
branches.cn: 说服：把问题称为普遍，就把频率变成了行动理由。

intro.en: Prevalence is prae- plus valere plus -entia. The prefix marks superiority, the verb marks strength, and the suffix makes an abstract noun.
intro.cn: prevalence 由 prae- 加 valere 加 -entia 构成。前缀标记优势，动词标记力量，后缀构成抽象名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin valere 'be strong' yields praevalere 'prevail' and praevalentia 'prevalence'. The same valere gives value, valid and valour.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 valere“强壮”产出 praevalere“占优势”与 praevalentia“普遍”。同一 valere 还产出 value、valid、valour。

items.meaning: to be widespread or to win out
items.example: Cooler weather prevailed after the storm.
items.exampleCN: 风暴之后凉爽天气占了上风。

items.meaningCN: 普遍的；流行的（-ent 形容词）
items.example: The belief is prevalent in rural areas.
items.exampleCN: 这种观念在农村地区很普遍。

items.meaningCN: 普遍；流行程度（-ence 抽象名词）
items.example: Prevalence rose after the ban was lifted.
items.exampleCN: 禁令解除后，流行程度上升了。

items.example: The prevailing wind comes from the west.
The species is prevalently found in wet soil.
items.exampleCN: 该物种普遍见于湿土中。

items.example: The value of the land doubled.
items.exampleCN: 这块地的价值翻了一番。

items.example: The ticket is valid for one day.
The soldier was decorated for valour.
items.exampleCN: 这名士兵因英勇受到嘉奖。

latinEntries.meaning: to be strong, be well, be worth

definition_en: existing widely, common in a place, group or period, or currently dominant
core_image: 街角每家店铺都挂着同一款式的风铃，风一吹整条街都在响
scene: The belief is prevalent among first-year students.
sceneCN: 这里 prevalent 是「普遍的、流行的」（第 1 个义项：在人群中广泛存在）；句意：这种看法在一年级学生中很普遍。图中可辨识物件：连成排的店铺、同款风铃、被风吹起的一片铃声。

senses.title: Common in a group
senses.titleCN: 普遍的：在这群人中到处都有
senses.definition: found widely among the members of a particular group
senses.definitionCN: 在某一特定群体的成员中广泛存在
senses.example: The fear of public speaking is prevalent among new teachers.
senses.exampleCN: 害怕当众讲话在新教师中很普遍。
senses.why: prevalere means 'to be stronger, prevail'. What prevails over a group is found throughout it, so the adjective describes wide presence.
senses.whyCN: prevalere 意为“更强、占优势”。在一群人中占优势的东西遍布其中，因此形容词描述“广泛存在”。

senses.title: Dominant opinion
senses.titleCN: 占上风的看法
senses.definition: currently accepted or believed by most people, whether or not it is correct
senses.definitionCN: 当前被多数人接受或相信的，无论是否正确
senses.example: The prevalent view was that the climate would not change.
senses.exampleCN: 当时占上风的看法是气候不会改变。
senses.why: The word reports strength of acceptance, not truth. A prevalent error is still prevalent.
senses.whyCN: 这个词报告的是被接受的程度，不是真伪。普遍的错误依然“普遍”。

senses.title: Medical frequency
senses.titleCN: 医学上的常见：病例很多
senses.definition: describing a disease or condition that affects a large share of a population
senses.definitionCN: 描述影响大量人口的疾病或状况
senses.example: The disease is prevalent in areas without clean water.
senses.exampleCN: 这种病在没有清洁水源的地区很常见。
senses.why: Public health uses the adjective where prevalence is high: the condition is not rare, so it changes policy.
senses.whyCN: 公共卫生在患病率高时用这个形容词：该状况不罕见，因此会影响政策。

senses.title: Dominant wind or weather
senses.titleCN: 主导风向：常刮的那一股
senses.definition: in meteorology, describing the wind direction most often recorded in an area
senses.definitionCN: 气象学上描述某地出现最多的风向
senses.example: The prevalent wind in July comes from the southwest.
senses.exampleCN: 七月的主导风来自西南。
senses.why: Weather statistics use prevalence as frequency dominance: the direction that prevails is the one that comes most often.
senses.whyCN: 气象统计把“普遍”当作“频率占优”：占上风的风向就是出现最多的那个。

senses.title: Prevailing custom
senses.titleCN: 盛行的习俗：多数人这么做
senses.definition: describing a practice or custom that most people in a society follow
senses.definitionCN: 描述一个社会中多数人遵循的做法或习俗
senses.example: Early marriage was prevalent in the village a century ago.
senses.exampleCN: 一个世纪前，早婚在这个村子里很盛行。
senses.why: Customs spread by imitation, so the social version of the word measures how many people copy a behaviour.
senses.whyCN: 习俗靠模仿传播，所以这个词的社会版本度量“有多少人照着做”。

senses.title: Commonest form
senses.titleCN: 最常见的形态：多数属于这一类
senses.definition: describing the most frequent type or variant within a category
senses.definitionCN: 描述某一类别中最常见的类型或变体
senses.example: The prevalent form of the gene differs by region.
senses.exampleCN: 该基因的常见形态随地区而异。
senses.why: Biology counts variants, so prevalent marks the variant with the largest share rather than with the greatest power.
senses.whyCN: 生物学统计变体，所以 prevalent 标记占比最大的那一种，而非最强的那一种。

senses.title: Legal 'prevailing' party
senses.titleCN: 法律上的胜诉方（相关用法）
senses.definition: in legal usage, the related participle prevailing describes the side that wins; prevalent itself means common
senses.definitionCN: 法律用语中相关分词 prevailing 指胜诉一方，而 prevalent 本身意为“普遍”
senses.example: The prevailing party may recover costs.
senses.exampleCN: 胜诉方可以收回诉讼费用。
senses.why: The two forms split: prevailing keeps the courtroom sense of winning, while prevalent keeps the statistical sense of being common.
senses.whyCN: 两个形式分工：prevailing 保留法庭上“胜出”的义，prevalent 保留统计上“常见”的义。

senses.title: Contrast with rare
senses.titleCN: 与“罕见”相对
senses.definition: occupying the high end of a frequency scale, opposed to rare or uncommon
senses.definitionCN: 处在频率刻度的高端，与罕见、少见相对
senses.example: Such storms are prevalent in autumn but rare in spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这样的风暴在秋季常见，在春季罕见。
senses.why: A scale needs both ends. Prevalent is only meaningful against rare, which is why the two words so often appear together.
senses.whyCN: 刻度需要两端。prevalent 只有与“罕见”对照才有意义，所以两词常一起出现。

intro.en: Prevalent is the adjective from Latin praevalere 'to be stronger, prevail' (prae- 'before, beyond' + valere 'be strong'), with the ending -ent from Latin -ent-.
intro.cn: prevalent 是拉丁 praevalere“更强、占优势”（prae-“在前、超过”+ valere“强壮”）的形容词形式，词尾 -ent 来自拉丁 -ent-。

items.en: valere meant 'to be strong, be well, be worth'. It also gives value and valid, so the family is about strength and worth, not about quantity.
items.cn: valere 意为“强壮、健康、有价值”。它还产出 value 与 valid，因此这个词族关乎力量与价值，不关乎数量。

items.en: prae- 'beyond' plus valere gives 'to be stronger than'. The verb first meant winning, then holding sway generally.
items.cn: prae-“超过”加 valere 得“强过”。动词先指取胜，后泛指占据优势。

items.en: the present participle praevalens 'prevailing' became the adjective source for English prevalent.
items.cn: 现在分词 praevalens“占优势的”成为英语 prevalent 的形容词来源。

items.en: English adopts prevalent in the 1500s, first for something having great force or influence, then for something widespread.
items.cn: 英语在 16 世纪采用 prevalent，先指“有强大力量或影响”，后指“广泛存在”。

items.en: Modern usage fixes the quantitative sense: a prevalent disease is one with many existing cases.
items.cn: 现代用法固定了数量义：“常见病”就是现有病例很多。

items.en: In ordinary speech prevalent now simply means common, and its natural partner is rare.
items.cn: 在日常口语中，prevalent 现在就是“常见”，它的天然搭档是“罕见”。

note.en: The look-alike group shares val- or the pre- prefix; the near-meaning group all say 'common', differing in tone and scale.
note.cn: 形近组共享 val- 或 pre- 前缀；近义组都表“常见”，差别在语气与尺度。

entries.definition: the fact of being widespread or the measured rate. The noun names the state; the adjective describes the thing.
entries.definitionCN: 普遍存在或测得的比率。名词命名状态，形容词描述事物。

entries.definition: current, dominant, or winning. It often modifies wind, opinion or a legal party, and stresses current dominance.
entries.definitionCN: 当前的；主导的；胜诉的。常修饰风、意见或法律当事方，强调当下占优。

entries.definition: intended to stop something from happening. It shares pre- but comes from venire 'to come', not valere.
entries.definitionCN: 预防性的。它共享 pre- 前缀，但来自 venire“来”，并非 valere。

entries.definition: occurring often or shared by many. It is the everyday word, with no trace of 'prevailing force'.
entries.definitionCN: 常见的；共同的。它是日常词，不带“占优势力量”的痕迹。

entries.definition: found over a large area. It stresses geography, while prevalent can stress a group or a period.
entries.definitionCN: 分布广泛的。它强调地理范围，而 prevalent 可强调群体或时期。

entries.definition: most powerful or noticeable. It stresses control, while prevalent stresses how many share something.
entries.definitionCN: 占支配地位的。它强调控制，而 prevalent 强调有多少人共有。

entries.definition: widespread, usually of something bad. It adds a negative judgment that prevalent does not carry.
entries.definitionCN: 猖獗的；充斥的。通常指坏事，带有 prevalent 所没有的负面判断。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词。

normal.en: The verb prevail means 'to hold sway', so prevalent describes what holds sway across a group.
normal.cn: 动词 prevail 意为“占上风”，所以 prevalent 描述“在一群人中占上风”的东西。

normal.en: prevalent among and prevalent in are the two frames: one for people, one for places.
normal.cn: 与人群连用、与地点连用是两个框架：一个接人群，一个接地点。

normal.en: The noun prevalence supplies the rate; the adjective supplies the description.
normal.cn: 名词 prevalence 提供比率，形容词提供描述。

normal.en: A prevalent wind is simply the wind that blows most often, which shows the scale meaning clearly.
normal.cn: 主导风就是刮得最多的风，清楚显示了“频率占优”的含义。

normal.en: Its natural opposite is rare, and the pair often appears in the same sentence.
normal.cn: 它的天然反义是“罕见”，两者常出现在同一句里。

abstract.en: Picture one style of doorbell on every house along a street.
abstract.cn: 想象一条街上每家每户都装同款门铃。

abstract.en: Picture a weather vane that points the same way on most days of the year.
abstract.cn: 想象风向标在一年大多数日子指向同一方向。

abstract.en: Picture a colour that fills most of a mosaic, leaving a few tiles of another shade.
abstract.cn: 想象一种颜色占满马赛克的大部分，只留下几块别的颜色。

examples.en: The practice is prevalent in coastal villages.
examples.cn: 这一做法在沿海村庄很普遍。

examples.en: Malnutrition remains prevalent in the drought zone.
examples.cn: 营养不良在旱区依然普遍。

examples.en: The prevalent assumption turned out to be false.
examples.cn: 那个普遍接受的假设最终被证明是错的。

dict_mnemonic.text: “普瑞沃伦特”音近 prevalent：普普通通“沃”得到处都是、连成一“特”——到处都有 → prevalent 普遍的

root: 拉丁 prae-“在前、超过”+ valere“强壮”→ praevalere“占优势”；praevalent- 词干 + -ent 形容词后缀。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all say that something is found in many places or many people, and the differences come from what is being counted.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都说“某物在许多地方或许多人身上出现”，差别在被计数的对象。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one style repeated on every street corner.
core.cn: 核心意象：每个街角都重复着同一种样式。

branches.en: PEOPLE AND CUSTOM: a fear among teachers and an early-marriage custom are both widely copied behaviours.
branches.cn: 人群与习俗：教师的恐惧与早婚习俗都是被广泛模仿的行为。

branches.en: DOMINANCE: a prevailing view and a prevailing wind both hold sway by being the most frequent.
branches.cn: 占优：主导看法与主导风都因最常见而占上风。

branches.en: COUNTED POPULATIONS: disease cases and gene variants are measured by share.
branches.cn: 被计数的人群：病例与基因变体都按占比衡量。

branches.en: LEGAL SPLIT: prevailing keeps the courtroom sense of winning, while prevalent keeps the statistical sense.
branches.cn: 法律分工：prevailing 保留法庭“胜诉”义，prevalent 保留统计义。

branches.en: SCALE: common only means something against rare.
branches.cn: 刻度：常见只有对照罕见才有意义。

intro.en: Prevalent is prae- plus valere plus -ent. The prefix marks superiority, the verb marks strength, and the suffix makes the adjective of a participle.
intro.cn: prevalent 由 prae- 加 valere 加 -ent 构成。前缀标记优势，动词标记力量，后缀把分词构成形容词。

latinIntro.en: Latin valere 'be strong' → praevalere 'prevail' → praevalens 'prevailing'. English keeps the stem prevalent- and adds no new prefix.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 valere“强壮”→ praevalere“占优势”→ praevalens“占优势的”。英语保留 prevalent- 词干，未加新前缀。

items.example: The custom is prevalent in the south.
items.exampleCN: 这一习俗在南方很盛行。

items.example: The value of the house rose.

definition_en: the act of stopping something from happening, or the measures taken to stop it before it starts
core_image: 一个人在坡顶把一块石头垫住，石头下方的村庄完好无损
scene: Prevention is cheaper than treatment in almost every health system.
sceneCN: 这里 prevention 是「预防、防止」（第 1 个义项：在事情发生前阻止它）；句意：在几乎所有卫生体系里，预防都比治疗便宜。图中可辨识物件：垫住石头的木楔、坡下完好的村庄。

senses.title: Stopping before it starts
senses.titleCN: 预防：在发生之前拦住
senses.definition: action taken to stop an event from happening at all
senses.definitionCN: 为使事件根本不发生而采取的行动
senses.example: Prevention of the fire required clearing the dry grass.
senses.exampleCN: 要预防这场火灾，必须清除干草。
senses.why: prae- 'before' plus venire 'come' gives praevenire, 'to come before'. To come before an event is to stop it arriving.
senses.whyCN: prae-“在前”加 venire“来”构成 praevenire“先到”。先于事件到达，就是阻止它到来。

senses.title: Public health prevention
senses.titleCN: 公共卫生：别让人得病
senses.definition: measures such as vaccination, clean water and screening that reduce the chance of illness
senses.definitionCN: 疫苗、清洁水源与筛查等降低患病几率的措施
senses.example: Prevention programmes cut child mortality sharply.
senses.exampleCN: 预防项目大幅降低了儿童死亡率。
senses.why: Medicine divides its work into preventing, treating and palliating. Prevention is the branch that acts on people who are still well.
senses.whyCN: 医学把工作分为预防、治疗与缓解。预防是作用于尚未患病者的那一支。

senses.title: Crime prevention
senses.titleCN: 犯罪预防：让事别发生
senses.definition: policies and designs that reduce the opportunity for crime
senses.definitionCN: 减少犯罪机会的政策与设计
senses.example: Better street lighting is a form of crime prevention.
senses.exampleCN: 改善路灯是犯罪预防的一种形式。
senses.why: Criminology borrows the medical frame: remove the conditions that let the harm occur rather than punish it afterwards.
senses.whyCN: 犯罪学借用了医学框架：移除让损害发生的条件，而不是事后惩罚。

senses.title: Fire and safety
senses.titleCN: 防火与安全：堵住起因
senses.definition: rules and equipment that stop fires or accidents from starting
senses.definitionCN: 防止火灾或事故发生的规则与设备
senses.example: Fire prevention inspections are required twice a year.
senses.exampleCN: 消防检查每年要求两次。
senses.why: Safety engineering works on causes rather than outcomes, which is exactly the before-the-event logic of the word.
senses.whyCN: 安全工程作用于原因而非结果，正是这个词“先于事件”的逻辑。

senses.title: Environmental prevention
senses.titleCN: 污染防治：别让它排出去
senses.definition: measures that stop pollution from being produced or released
senses.definitionCN: 阻止污染产生或被排放的措施
senses.example: Pollution prevention is cheaper than cleanup.
senses.exampleCN: 污染防治比清理更便宜。
senses.why: Environmental law prefers prevention because cleanup cannot fully undo damage, so the earlier point of action wins.
senses.whyCN: 环境法偏好预防，因为清理无法完全挽回损害，越早介入越有效。

senses.title: The proverb
senses.titleCN: 谚语：预防胜于治疗
senses.definition: in the fixed saying prevention is better than cure, the claim that early action costs less than repair
senses.definitionCN: 在固定谚语“预防胜于治疗”中，指早行动比事后修补代价更小
senses.example: Prevention is better than cure, as the old saying goes.
senses.exampleCN: 正如老话所说，预防胜于治疗。
senses.why: The proverb compresses an economic argument into a moral one: paying early is wiser than paying late.
senses.whyCN: 这句谚语把经济学论证压缩成道德论证：早付钱比晚付钱明智。

senses.title: Prevention versus treatment
senses.titleCN: 与治疗相对：管未病
senses.definition: the branch of policy or medicine concerned with those not yet affected, opposed to treatment
senses.definitionCN: 政策或医学中面向尚未受影响者的那一支，与治疗相对
senses.example: Budgets favour treatment over prevention because treatment is visible.
senses.exampleCN: 预算偏爱治疗而非预防，因为治疗看得见。
senses.why: Prevention is invisible when it succeeds, which is why it is chronically underfunded.
senses.whyCN: 预防成功时是看不见的，这正是它长期资金不足的原因。

senses.title: Prevention of recurrence
senses.titleCN: 防止复发：别再来一次
senses.definition: measures taken after a first event to stop it happening again
senses.definitionCN: 在第一次事件之后采取的措施，防止它再次发生
senses.example: Secondary prevention aims to stop a second heart attack.
senses.exampleCN: 二级预防旨在防止第二次心脏病发作。
senses.why: Medicine splits prevention into levels: primary stops onset, secondary stops recurrence. Both still act before the next event.
senses.whyCN: 医学把预防分级：一级预防阻止初发，二级预防阻止复发。两者都在下一次事件之前行动。

intro.en: Prevention comes from Latin praevenire 'to come before, anticipate', from prae- 'before' plus venire 'to come'. The noun is praeventio.
intro.cn: prevention 来自拉丁 praevenire“先到、预先”，由 prae-“在前”加 venire“来”构成，名词为 praeventio。

items.en: venire 'to come' is the base. It also gives event, invent, intervene and convention, each with a different prefix.
items.cn: venire“来”是基础词根。它还产出 event、invent、intervene、convention，各自前缀不同。

items.en: prae- 'before' plus venire produced praevenire, 'to come before'. The sense shifts from arriving first to hindering by arriving first.
items.cn: prae-“在前”加 venire 构成 praevenire“先到”。词义从“先到”转为“因先到而拦住”。

items.en: The noun praeventio named a coming before and, in later use, a hindering or forestalling.
items.cn: 名词 praeventio 指“先到”，晚期用法中指“阻止、预先拦下”。

items.en: English borrows prevention in the 1500s, first in theology for divine prevention of evil, then in medicine.
items.cn: 英语在 16 世纪借入 prevention，最早见于神学中“神阻止恶”，后进入医学。

items.en: The 19th century sanitarian movement makes prevention a policy word: clean water and sewers come before hospitals.
items.cn: 19 世纪卫生运动让 prevention 成为政策词：清洁水源与下水道先于医院。

items.en: In the 20th century the word extends to crime, fire, pollution and accidents, always with the same before-the-event logic.
items.cn: 20 世纪，这个词扩展到犯罪、火灾、污染与事故，始终保留“先于事件”的逻辑。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the ven- stem or the pre- prefix; the near-meaning group all reduce risk, but differ in timing and method.
note.cn: 形近组共享 ven- 词干或 pre- 前缀；近义组都降低风险，差别在时机与方法。

entries.definition: to stop something happening. The verb is the act; prevention is the act or the policy built on it.
entries.definitionCN: 阻止；预防。动词是动作，prevention 是动作或由此形成的政策。

entries.definition: intended to prevent. It describes measures, while prevention names the whole effort.
entries.definitionCN: 预防性的。它描述措施，prevention 命名整体努力。

entries.definition: action taken to change a situation already under way. It comes from inter- plus venire, and acts during, not before.
entries.definitionCN: 干预。来自 inter- 加 venire，作用于进行中的事，而非之前。

entries.definition: medical action taken to prevent disease. It is the clinical term for what prevention means in public health.
entries.definitionCN: 预防；防病措施。它是公共卫生所说“预防”的临床术语。

entries.definition: a single measure taken to avoid harm. Prevention is the general aim; a precaution is one move toward it.
entries.definitionCN: 预防措施。预防是总目标，防范措施是迈向它的一个动作。

entries.definition: keeping away from something harmful. It stresses staying apart, while prevention can also remove causes.
entries.definitionCN: 避开。强调不接触，而“预防”也可指移除原因。

entries.definition: discouraging action by threat of punishment. It works on motivation, while prevention works on conditions.
entries.definitionCN: 威慑。它作用于动机，而“预防”作用于条件。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词。

normal.en: venire means 'come', so prevention is literally 'coming before' the event.
normal.cn: venire 意为“来”，所以 prevention 字面就是“先于事件到达”。

normal.en: The family prevent, prevention, preventive, preventable keeps the same stem and the same before-logic.
normal.cn: prevent、prevention、preventive、preventable 全族保持同一词干与同一“预先”逻辑。

normal.en: Crime prevention, fire prevention and pollution prevention all remove the condition, not the person.
normal.cn: 犯罪预防、防火、污染防治都在移除条件，而不是移除人。

normal.en: The proverb prevention is better than cure is the most memorable carrier of the word.
normal.cn: 谚语“预防胜于治疗”是这个词最易记的载体。

normal.en: Intervention comes from the same venire but acts in the middle, which is why the two words are near opposites.
normal.cn: intervention 同出 venire，却作用于中途，因此两词近乎相反。

abstract.en: Picture a wedge under a boulder before it starts to roll.
abstract.cn: 想象石头开始滚动之前就垫上的木楔。

abstract.en: Picture a fence built at the top of a cliff rather than an ambulance at the bottom.
abstract.cn: 想象在崖顶建栅栏，而不是在崖底备救护车。

abstract.en: Picture a match that is never struck.
abstract.cn: 想象一根始终没有被划着的火柴。

examples.en: Prevention of malaria depends on nets and standing water.
examples.cn: 疟疾预防取决于蚊帐与积水治理。

examples.en: The city spends more on prevention than on firefighting.
examples.cn: 这座城市在预防上的花费超过灭火。

examples.en: Prevention is better than cure, but it is harder to photograph.
examples.cn: 预防胜于治疗，却更难被拍到。

dict_mnemonic.text: “普瑞文神”音近 prevention：先“文”住、再像有“神”力一样挡住——在事情发生前拦住 → prevention 预防

root: 拉丁 prae-“在前”+ venire“来”→ praevenire“先到、预先拦下”→ praeventio；英语取 praeventio(n-) 词干 + -ion。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all act before the event, differing only in whether the event is disease, crime, fire, pollution or a second attack.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在事件之前行动，差别只在事件是疾病、犯罪、火灾、污染还是第二次发作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wedge under a stone before it rolls.
core.cn: 核心意象：石头滚动之前垫上的木楔。

branches.en: BEFORE THE EVENT: the plain act and the proverb are the same economic logic in two registers.
branches.cn: 事件之前：普通动作与谚语是同一经济逻辑的两种语体。

branches.en: TWO BRANCHES: public health prevention and treatment face the same patients from opposite sides of illness.
branches.cn: 两个分支：公共卫生的预防与治疗从疾病的两侧面对同一批人。

branches.en: SOCIAL AND PHYSICAL SAFETY: crime and fire are both stopped by removing conditions.
branches.cn: 社会与物理安全：犯罪与火灾都靠移除条件来阻止。

branches.en: ENVIRONMENT: prevention beats cleanup because damage cannot be fully undone.
branches.cn: 环境：预防胜过清理，因为损害无法完全挽回。

branches.en: LEVELS: primary prevention stops onset, secondary prevention stops recurrence.
branches.cn: 层级：一级预防阻止初发，二级预防阻止复发。

intro.en: Prevention is prae- plus venire plus -ion. The prefix marks coming early, the verb marks arrival, and the suffix makes the act a noun.
intro.cn: prevention 由 prae- 加 venire 加 -ion 构成。前缀标记早到，动词标记到来，后缀把动作变成名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin venire 'come' yields praevenire 'come before' and praeventio. The same venire builds event, invent and intervene with other prefixes.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 venire“来”产出 praevenire“先到”与 praeventio。同一 venire 与其他前缀构成 event、invent、intervene。

items.meaning: the act of stopping something early
items.meaningCN: 预防；防止（-ion 动作名词）

items.example: Most of these deaths are preventable.
items.exampleCN: 这些死亡大多可以预防。

items.meaning: one that prevents, or a safety device
items.example: A backflow preventer protects the water line.

items.meaning: same as preventive, an alternative form
to step in during an event
items.example: The teacher intervened before the fight.

items.meaning: something that comes out, an occurrence
items.example: The event drew a large crowd.
items.exampleCN: 这场活动吸引了大批人。

definition_zh: 预防性的；预防的；预防措施
definition_en: intended to stop something from happening, or a measure taken for that purpose
core_image: 一辆检修车停在铁路边，轨道还没裂，工人已经在换那根旧螺栓
scene: Preventive checks caught the crack before the bridge was used.
sceneCN: 这里 preventive 是「预防性的」（第 1 个义项：为阻止事情发生而做的）；句意：预防性检查在桥梁启用之前就发现了裂缝。图中可辨识物件：检修车、尚未裂开的轨道、换下的旧螺栓。

senses.title: Serving to stop something
senses.titleCN: 预防性的：为了拦住它
senses.definition: designed or intended to stop an unwanted event before it occurs
senses.definitionCN: 旨在在不受欢迎的事件发生之前将其阻止
senses.example: The school installed preventive barriers at the stairwell.
senses.exampleCN: 学校在楼梯口安装了预防性护栏。
senses.why: The -ive suffix marks function. Preventive describes what a measure is for, not what it has already done.
senses.whyCN: -ive 后缀标记功能。preventive 描述措施“为了什么”，而不是“已经做了什么”。

senses.title: Preventive medicine
senses.titleCN: 预防医学：治未病
senses.definition: the branch of medicine concerned with avoiding disease rather than treating it
senses.definitionCN: 关注避免疾病而非治疗疾病的医学分支
senses.example: Preventive medicine focuses on vaccination and screening.
senses.exampleCN: 预防医学侧重疫苗接种与筛查。
senses.why: Medicine splits by timing. Preventive work happens while the patient is well, which is why it is a separate branch.
senses.whyCN: 医学按时机分工。预防工作发生在病人还健康时，因此成为独立分支。

senses.title: Preventive measures
senses.titleCN: 预防措施：提前做的那几件事
senses.definition: countable steps taken in advance to reduce a risk
senses.definitionCN: 为降低风险而提前采取的可数步骤
senses.example: The report lists ten preventive measures for the factory.
senses.exampleCN: 报告为这家工厂列出十项预防措施。
senses.why: As a noun the word names concrete items, so a policy becomes a checklist of steps rather than a principle.
senses.whyCN: 作名词时它命名具体条目，于是政策变成一张步骤清单，而非一条原则。

senses.title: Preventive war
senses.titleCN: 预防性战争：趁对方还没强起来
senses.definition: describing war launched to stop an opponent from becoming a future threat, distinct from preemptive war
senses.definitionCN: 描述为阻止对手成为未来威胁而发动的战争，区别于先发制人的战争
senses.example: Preventive war is illegal under the modern law of conflict.
senses.exampleCN: 依据现代冲突法，预防性战争是非法的。
senses.why: The distinction is legal and precise: preemptive strikes answer an imminent attack, preventive war answers a distant one.
senses.whyCN: 这一区分是法律性且精确的：先发制人回应迫在眉睫的攻击，预防性战争回应遥远的威胁。

senses.title: Preventive detention
senses.titleCN: 预防性拘留：先关起来防出事
senses.definition: in law, detention ordered to stop a person from committing future harm rather than to punish past acts
senses.definitionCN: 法律上指为防止某人将来造成损害而非惩罚其过去行为的拘留
senses.example: Preventive detention raises serious human rights questions.
senses.exampleCN: 预防性拘留引发严重的人权问题。
senses.why: Law usually punishes the past. Preventive detention acts on the future, which is exactly why it is controversial.
senses.whyCN: 法律通常惩罚过去。预防性拘留作用于未来，这正是它受争议的原因。

senses.title: Preventive maintenance
senses.titleCN: 预防性维护：坏了之前先修
senses.definition: scheduled servicing of equipment based on time or use, before failure occurs
senses.definitionCN: 按时间或使用量在故障发生前安排的设备保养
senses.example: Preventive maintenance is cheaper than emergency repair.
senses.exampleCN: 预防性维护比紧急抢修便宜。
senses.why: Engineering splits maintenance into reactive and preventive. The adjective marks the version that acts before the breakdown.
senses.whyCN: 工程把维护分为事后与预防。这个形容词标记“在故障之前”的那一种。

senses.title: Preventive diplomacy
senses.titleCN: 预防性外交：别让争端打起来
senses.definition: diplomatic action taken to stop a dispute from becoming violent
senses.definitionCN: 为防止争端升级为暴力而采取的外交行动
senses.example: Preventive diplomacy kept the border talks alive.
senses.exampleCN: 预防性外交让边界谈判得以延续。
senses.why: Diplomacy borrows the medical word: conflict is treated like a disease that can be caught early.
senses.whyCN: 外交借用了医学词：冲突被视为一种可以早期发现的疾病。

senses.title: Preventive check
senses.titleCN: 预防性限制：经济思想里的旧词
senses.definition: in historical economics, Malthus's preventive checks are the limits people place on population growth themselves
senses.definitionCN: 在经济学史中，马尔萨斯的“预防性限制”指人们自行对人口增长施加的限制
senses.example: Malthus called delayed marriage a preventive check.
senses.exampleCN: 马尔萨斯把推迟婚姻称为一种预防性限制。
senses.why: The word was used long before medicine made it common, and this economic sense shows its general logic: act on the cause before the effect.
senses.whyCN: 这个词在医学让它流行之前就已被使用，这一经济学义显示了它的普遍逻辑：在结果之前作用于原因。

intro.en: Preventive is prevent plus -ive, from Latin praevenire 'to come before, forestall' (prae- 'before' + venire 'come').
intro.cn: preventive 是 prevent 加 -ive，源自拉丁 praevenire“先到、预先拦下”（prae-“在前”+ venire“来”）。

items.en: venire 'to come' underlies the family. Event, invent, intervene and convention all use the same stem with different prefixes.
items.cn: venire“来”是该词族的基础。event、invent、intervene、convention 都用同一词干，配不同前缀。

items.en: prae- 'before' plus venire gives 'to come before'. The practical sense 'to hinder' grows from arriving first.
items.cn: prae-“在前”加 venire 得“先到”。由于先到，实用义“拦住”生长出来。

items.en: -ivus in Latin marks capacity or function, so preventive means 'having the function of preventing'.
items.cn: 拉丁 -ivus 标记能力或功能，所以 preventive 意为“具有阻止的功能”。

items.en: English uses preventive first as a noun for a remedy that wards off illness, then as an adjective.
items.cn: 英语最早把 preventive 用作名词，指防病之物，随后用作形容词。

items.en: In the 19th and 20th centuries preventive medicine becomes the name of a whole branch of practice.
items.cn: 19 至 20 世纪，预防医学成为整个实践分支的名称。

items.en: The same adjective spreads to detention, war, maintenance and diplomacy, where the shared point is action before harm.
items.cn: 同一形容词扩展到拘留、战争、维护与外交，共同点是“在损害之前行动”。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the ven- stem or the pre- prefix; the near-meaning group all act early, differing in whether they stop or prepare.
note.cn: 形近组共享 ven- 词干或 pre- 前缀；近义组都提早行动，差别在“阻止”还是“准备”。

entries.definition: the act or policy of stopping something. The noun names the effort; the adjective describes measures.
entries.definitionCN: 预防的行为或政策。名词命名努力，形容词描述措施。

entries.definition: an alternative form of preventive, common in speech and some writing. Both are accepted.
entries.definitionCN: preventive 的变体形式，口语和一些写作中常见，两者都被接受。

entries.definition: acting first against an imminent threat. It comes from pre- plus emere 'buy, take', not from venire.
entries.definitionCN: 先发制人的。来自 pre- 加 emere“买、取”，并非 venire。

entries.definition: describing treatment given to ward off disease. It is the clinical adjective for preventive in medicine.
entries.definitionCN: 预防性的。它是医学中 preventive 的临床形容词。

entries.definition: done to avoid possible harm. It stresses caution rather than a systematic programme.
entries.definitionCN: 防范性的。强调谨慎，而非系统性的方案。

entries.definition: describing something that shields from harm. It implies a barrier, while preventive implies earlier action.
entries.definitionCN: 保护性的。暗含屏障，而 preventive 暗含更早的行动。

entries.definition: able to cure a condition already present. It is the natural counterpart of preventive.
entries.definitionCN: 治疗性的。它是 preventive 的天然对照词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词。

normal.en: -ive marks function, so preventive means 'doing the job of stopping'.
normal.cn: -ive 标记功能，所以 preventive 意为“承担阻止任务”。

normal.en: Preventive maintenance is the clearest everyday example: repair before the machine breaks.
normal.cn: 预防性维护是最清楚的日常例子：在机器坏之前先修。

normal.en: Preventive versus curative is a timing pair, not a quality pair.
normal.cn: 预防与治疗是一对时机词，不是一对质量词。

normal.en: Preventive war is legally different from preemptive war, and the difference is the distance of the threat.
normal.cn: 预防性战争与先发制人战争在法律上不同，差别在威胁的远近。

normal.en: Preventive detention is controversial precisely because it acts on the future rather than the past.
normal.cn: 预防性拘留之所以有争议，正因为它作用于未来而非过去。

abstract.en: Picture a mechanic replacing a bearing that still turns quietly.
abstract.cn: 想象机械师换下一个仍在安静转动的轴承。

abstract.en: Picture a fence put up while the field is still empty.
abstract.cn: 想象田里还空着时就立起的围栏。

abstract.en: Picture a doctor's appointment scheduled while the patient feels fine.
abstract.cn: 想象病人在感觉良好时预约的那次体检。

examples.en: Preventive treatment reduced the number of severe cases.
examples.cn: 预防性治疗减少了重症病例数。

examples.en: The airline follows a preventive maintenance schedule.
examples.cn: 该航空公司执行预防性维护计划。

examples.en: Preventive steps are cheaper, but they are invisible when they work.
examples.cn: 预防措施更便宜，但奏效时却看不见。

dict_mnemonic.text: “普瑞文提夫”音近 preventive：先“文”住口子、再“提”前防住——提前挡住不让发生 → preventive 预防性的

root: 拉丁 prae-“在前”+ venire“来”→ praevenire“先到、预先拦下”；prevent + -ive（拉丁 -ivus，表功能）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all describe measures that act before the harm, whether the harm is illness, war, crime or a broken bearing.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都描述“在损害之前行动”的措施，无论损害是疾病、战争、犯罪还是坏掉的轴承。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bolt replaced before the rail cracks.
core.cn: 核心意象：轨道裂开之前换下的螺栓。

branches.en: FUNCTION AND ITEMS: the adjective describes the purpose, the countable noun lists the steps.
branches.cn: 功能与条目：形容词描述目的，可数名词列出步骤。

branches.en: MEDICINE: preventive work happens while the patient is well, which defines the branch.
branches.cn: 医学：预防工作发生在病人健康时，这定义了该分支。

branches.en: LAW: preventive war and preventive detention both act on a future harm, which is why both are contested.
branches.cn: 法律：预防性战争与预防性拘留都作用于未来的损害，因此都受争议。

branches.en: ENGINEERING: maintenance before failure is the industrial model of the same logic.
branches.cn: 工程：故障前的维护是同一逻辑的工业模型。

branches.en: SOCIETY: diplomacy and Malthus's checks apply the word to conflict and population.
branches.cn: 社会：外交与马尔萨斯的限制把词用于冲突与人口。

intro.en: Preventive is prevent plus -ive. The base carries 'come before', the suffix marks function, and the noun prevention carries the policy.
intro.cn: preventive 是 prevent 加 -ive。词基携带“先到”，后缀标记功能，名词 prevention 承载政策含义。

latinIntro.en: Latin venire 'come' → praevenire 'forestall'. English keeps vent- in prevent and adds -ive from -ivus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 venire“来”→ praevenire“预先拦下”。英语在 prevent 中保留 vent-，加 -ive（来自 -ivus）。

definition_zh: 生产率；生产力；产出效率
definition_en: the rate at which work produces output, measured as output per unit of labour, land or capital
core_image: 一台机器前站着一名工人，出口处的成品箱一层层堆高，时钟却只走了一小格
scene: Productivity rose after the old machines were replaced.
sceneCN: 这里 productivity 是「生产率」（第 1 个义项：单位投入的产出效率）；句意：旧机器更换之后生产率上升了。图中可辨识物件：机器、工人、堆高的成品箱、只走了一小格的时钟。

pos.zh: 生产率；生产力；产出效率

senses.title: Output per input
senses.titleCN: 生产率：一份投入换多少产出
senses.definition: the ratio of output produced to the input used, such as hours worked or land farmed
senses.definitionCN: 产出与所用投入（如工时或耕地）之比
senses.example: Productivity doubled after the assembly line was redesigned.
senses.exampleCN: 装配线重新设计后，生产率翻了一番。
senses.why: producere means 'to lead forth'. Productivity measures how much is led forth from a given effort, which makes it a ratio.
senses.whyCN: producere 意为“向前引出”。生产率衡量一份投入能引出多少产出，所以它是一个比率。

senses.title: Labour productivity
senses.titleCN: 劳动生产率：每人每小时产出
senses.definition: output per hour or per worker, the most common economic measure
senses.definitionCN: 每工时或每人产出，最常见的经济指标
senses.example: Labour productivity in manufacturing grew by three percent.
senses.exampleCN: 制造业劳动生产率增长百分之三。
senses.why: Hours are the denominator economists use most, because labour is the input that can be counted most cleanly.
senses.whyCN: 工时是经济学家最常用的分母，因为劳动是最容易清楚计数的投入。

senses.title: Agricultural productivity
senses.titleCN: 农业生产力：一亩地打多少粮
senses.definition: output per hectare or per farm worker in farming
senses.definitionCN: 农业中每公顷或每个农业劳动者的产出
senses.example: Higher agricultural productivity freed workers for cities.
senses.exampleCN: 农业生产力提高，使劳动者得以流向城市。
senses.why: Land was the original denominator. When yields rise, the same field feeds more people, and that is productivity.
senses.whyCN: 土地是最初的分母。产量提高时，同一块田能养活更多人，这就是生产力。

senses.title: Productivity growth
senses.titleCN: 生产率增长：效率在变好
senses.definition: the rate at which the output-to-input ratio improves over time
senses.definitionCN: 产出与投入之比随时间改善的速度
senses.example: Productivity growth stalled for a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 生产率增长停滞了十年。
senses.why: Growth turns a level into a trend. Economists care about the direction because small yearly gains compound.
senses.whyCN: 增长把水平变成趋势。经济学家关心方向，因为每年小幅提升会复利累积。

senses.title: Office productivity
senses.titleCN: 办公效率：工具让你更快
senses.definition: in computing and marketing, the capacity of a person or tool to complete work, as in productivity software
senses.definitionCN: 在计算与营销语境中指人或工具完成工作的能力，如办公效率软件
senses.example: The suite is sold as productivity software.
senses.exampleCN: 这套软件以办公效率软件的名义出售。
senses.why: Software marketing borrowed the economic word and dropped the denominator, so it now means roughly 'gets work done'.
senses.whyCN: 软件营销借用了经济词却去掉了分母，于是现在大致意为“能把活干完”。

senses.title: Total factor productivity
senses.titleCN: 全要素生产率：剩下那部分增长
senses.definition: the part of output growth not explained by more labour or capital, often taken as technical progress
senses.definitionCN: 产出增长中无法由劳动或资本增加解释的部分，常被视为技术进步
senses.example: Total factor productivity explains most long-run growth.
senses.exampleCN: 全要素生产率解释了大部分长期增长。
senses.why: Economics needs a residual for what it cannot measure. The term names that leftover, which is why it is also called the residual.
senses.whyCN: 经济学需要一个“测不出来的剩余”。这个词命名那块剩余，所以它又叫残差。

senses.title: Ecological productivity
senses.titleCN: 生态生产力：生态系统造出多少有机物
senses.definition: in ecology, the rate at which an ecosystem produces biomass, as in primary productivity
senses.definitionCN: 生态学上指生态系统生产生物量的速率，如初级生产力
senses.example: Primary productivity in the lake fell after the bloom.
senses.exampleCN: 水华之后湖水的初级生产力下降。
senses.why: Ecology transfers the ratio from factories to living systems: sunlight and nutrients are the input, biomass is the output.
senses.whyCN: 生态学把比率从工厂搬到生命系统：阳光与养分是投入，生物量是产出。

senses.title: The productivity paradox
senses.titleCN: 生产率悖论：投了电脑却不见增长
senses.definition: the observed mismatch between heavy investment in technology and weak measured productivity growth
senses.definitionCN: 大量技术投入与测得的疲弱生产率增长之间的落差
senses.example: The productivity paradox delayed the promised office revolution.
senses.exampleCN: 生产率悖论推迟了人们许诺的办公革命。
senses.why: Measurement lag explains part of the paradox: gains appear only after work is reorganised around the new tools.
senses.whyCN: 测量滞后解释了部分悖论：只有围绕新工具重组工作后，收益才显现。

intro.en: Productivity comes from Latin producere 'to lead forth, bring out', from pro- 'forward' plus ducere 'to lead'. The abstract noun is productivitas, formed in later Latin.
intro.cn: productivity 来自拉丁 producere“向前引出、产生”，由 pro-“向前”加 ducere“引导”构成，抽象名词 productivitas 为晚期拉丁构成。

items.en: ducere meant 'to lead'. It underlies conduct, reduce, introduce and educate, each with its own prefix direction.
items.cn: ducere 意为“引导”。它支撑 conduct、reduce、introduce、educate，各接不同方向的前缀。

items.en: pro- 'forward' plus ducere gives producere, 'to lead or bring forth'. The image is leading something out into view.
items.cn: pro-“向前”加 ducere 构成 producere“引出、产生”。意象是把东西引出来让人看见。

items.en: The participle productum 'brought forth' gives English product: the thing led out. Production names the leading-out act.
items.cn: 分词 productum“被引出之物”给出英语 product。production 命名“引出”这个动作。

items.en: Later Latin forms productivitas on the adjective productivus, meaning 'having the power to produce'.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语以形容词 productivus“有产出能力的”构成 productivitas。

items.en: English adopts productivity in the age of agricultural improvement, first as the quality of being productive.
items.cn: 英语在农业改良时代采用 productivity，最初指“多产的性质”。

items.en: In the 20th century economics fixes the quantitative sense: output divided by input, tracked as a growth series.
items.cn: 20 世纪经济学固定了数量义：产出除以投入，作为增长序列来追踪。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the duc- stem or the -ivity ending; the near-meaning group all concern output, differing in unit and scale.
note.cn: 形近组共享 duc- 词干或 -ivity 结尾；近义组都关乎产出，差别在单位与尺度。

entries.definition: yielding results or output. The adjective describes the worker or land; productivity measures the ratio.
entries.definitionCN: 多产的；有成效的。形容词描述工人或土地，productivity 度量比率。

entries.definition: the total amount produced. It is a quantity, while productivity is that quantity per unit of input.
entries.definitionCN: 产量。它是总量，而 productivity 是每单位投入的产量。

entries.definition: the item produced. It is the noun for what comes out, not for how efficiently it came out.
entries.definitionCN: 产品。它命名产出物，而非产出效率。

entries.definition: the ratio of useful work to the energy or resources spent. It stresses waste avoided, while productivity stresses output per input.
entries.definitionCN: 效率。它强调避免了浪费，而 productivity 强调单位投入的产出。

entries.definition: the amount produced in a period. It is what productivity divides by input.
entries.definitionCN: 产出量。它是 productivity 用来除以投入的那个分子。

entries.definition: the amount harvested from land. It is a physical output, close to productivity when measured per hectare.
entries.definitionCN: 产量。它是土地的实物产出，按公顷衡量时接近 productivity。

entries.definition: the volume passing through a system in a time. It counts flow, not output per unit of effort.
entries.definitionCN: 吞吐量。它统计流量，而非单位投入的产出。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词。

normal.en: pro- 'forward' plus ducere 'lead' gives 'lead forth', which is the source of produce, product and productivity.
normal.cn: pro-“向前”加 ducere“引导”得“引出”，是 produce、product、productivity 的共同来源。

normal.en: The word is a fraction: output on top, input on the bottom. Every collocation names one of the two halves.
normal.cn: 这个词是一个分数：产出在上，投入在下。每个搭配都在给其中一半命名。

normal.en: Labour productivity puts hours on the bottom; agricultural productivity puts hectares on the bottom.
normal.cn: 劳动生产率把工时放在分母；农业生产力把公顷放在分母。

normal.en: Production is the total; productivity is the total divided by the effort.
normal.cn: production 是总量；productivity 是总量除以投入。

normal.en: The productivity paradox is the puzzle of paying for computers and not seeing the gain in the numbers.
normal.cn: 生产率悖论就是：花了钱买电脑，数字里却看不到收益。

abstract.en: Picture the same basket of apples carried out by fewer hands.
abstract.cn: 想象同样一篮苹果由更少的人手搬出来。

abstract.en: Picture a clock that finishes the shift while the pile of boxes is twice as high.
abstract.cn: 想象一个班次结束时，箱子堆得比原来高一倍。

abstract.en: Picture a field that feeds two families where it once fed one.
abstract.cn: 想象一块田从养活一户人家变成养活两户。

examples.en: Productivity in the port improved when the cranes were automated.
examples.cn: 港口起重机自动化后，生产率提高了。

examples.en: Wage growth has lagged behind productivity growth.
examples.cn: 工资增长落后于生产率增长。

examples.en: Primary productivity is highest in shallow coastal water.
examples.cn: 初级生产力在浅海沿岸水域最高。

dict_mnemonic.text: “普若达克提维梯”音近 productivity：先把东西“达”出来、再“克”住工时、效率就“提”上去 → productivity 生产率

root: 拉丁 pro-“向前”+ ducere“引导”→ producere“引出、产生”；productivus + -itas 构成抽象名词 productivity。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all measure how much comes out for what goes in, and the differences come from which input is counted.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都衡量“进去多少、出来多少”，差别在数的是哪一种投入。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: more boxes out of the same hours.
core.cn: 核心意象：同样的工时，搬出更多箱子。

branches.en: THE RATIO: the general fraction and the labour version differ only in the denominator.
branches.cn: 比率：一般分数与劳动版本只差分母。

branches.en: LAND: agriculture counts hectares, the oldest input measure.
branches.cn: 土地：农业按公顷计数，是最古老的投入度量。

branches.en: TRENDS AND PUZZLES: growth tracks the ratio over time, and the paradox notes when it fails to move.
branches.cn: 趋势与悖论：增长追踪比率随时间的变化，悖论指出它不动的时候。

branches.en: MARKETING: software drops the denominator and keeps only 'gets work done'.
branches.cn: 营销：软件抽掉了分母，只留下“能把活干完”。

branches.en: RESIDUAL AND BIOMASS: economics and ecology both measure what the obvious inputs cannot explain.
branches.cn: 剩余与生物量：经济学与生态学都度量“明显投入解释不了的部分”。

intro.en: Productivity is productiv- plus -ity. The stem carries 'leading forth', and the suffix turns an adjective of capacity into an abstract measure.
intro.cn: productivity 是 productiv- 加 -ity。词干携带“引出”，后缀把表能力的形容词变成抽象度量。

latinIntro.en: Latin ducere 'lead' → producere 'bring forth' → productivus 'producing'. The English family runs produce, product, production, productive, productivity.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ducere“引导”→ producere“引出”→ productivus“有产出能力的”。英语词族为 produce、product、production、productive、productivity。

items.meaning: the act or total of making

items.exampleCN: 这是一次有成效的会议。

items.meaning: in a way that yields results
items.exampleCN: 他们一上午都干得很有成效。

definition_zh: 多产的；富有成效的；有生产能力的
definition_en: producing a good amount of results, goods or growth, or tending to bring something about
core_image: 一棵果树压弯了枝，树下篮子已经装满，旁边还有空篮等着
scene: It was the most productive meeting of the year.
sceneCN: 这里 productive 是「富有成效的」（第 1 个义项：能带来大量成果的）；句意：这是全年最有成效的一次会议。图中可辨识物件：压弯的果枝、装满的篮子、旁边空着的篮子。

pos.zh: 多产的；富有成效的；有生产能力的

senses.title: Yielding results
senses.titleCN: 富有成效的：花了时间有回报
senses.definition: producing useful results, especially in relation to the effort spent
senses.definitionCN: 产生有用成果，尤指相对所花精力而言
senses.example: The negotiation was short but productive.
senses.exampleCN: 谈判很短，但富有成效。
senses.why: producere means 'to lead forth'. A productive hour is one that leads something out into the world.
senses.whyCN: producere 意为“引出”。富有成效的一小时，就是把东西引到世上的一小时。

senses.title: Fertile land
senses.titleCN: 多产的土地：种什么长什么
senses.definition: describing soil or land that yields large crops
senses.definitionCN: 描述能产出大量作物的土壤或土地
senses.example: The valley has some of the most productive soil in the country.
senses.exampleCN: 这个山谷拥有全国最肥沃高产的土地。
senses.why: Agriculture applies the word to the ground itself: the land leads forth crops, which is the original physical image.
senses.whyCN: 农业把这个词用于土地本身：土地引出作物，这正是最初的物理意象。

senses.title: A productive worker
senses.titleCN: 高效的劳动者：干得多、干得好
senses.definition: describing a person who produces a large amount of good work
senses.definitionCN: 描述能产出大量优质工作的人
senses.example: She is productive even when working from home.
senses.exampleCN: 她在家办公时也效率很高。
senses.why: The word moves from fields to people, measuring how much useful work a person brings out.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从田地移到人身上，衡量一个人能引出多少有用工作。

senses.title: Medical: productive cough
senses.titleCN: 医学：有痰的咳嗽
senses.definition: in medicine, describing a cough that brings up mucus, as opposed to a dry cough
senses.definitionCN: 医学上描述能咳出黏液的咳嗽，与干咳相对
senses.example: A productive cough usually means the airways are clearing.
senses.exampleCN: 有痰的咳嗽通常意味着气道在排出分泌物。
senses.why: Medicine uses the literal sense: the cough produces something. This shows how far the word has travelled from farms.
senses.whyCN: 医学使用字面义：咳嗽产出了东西。由此可见这个词离农田有多远。

senses.title: Productive discussion
senses.titleCN: 有产出的讨论：谈出了东西
senses.definition: describing conversation that generates ideas, decisions or plans
senses.definitionCN: 描述能产生想法、决定或计划的交谈
senses.example: The workshop ended with a productive list of options.
senses.exampleCN: 工作坊结束时得到了一份有产出的选项清单。
senses.why: Meetings are judged by what they lead forth, so the agricultural adjective becomes a judgment on talk.
senses.whyCN: 会议按其“引出什么”来评判，于是农业形容词变成了对谈话的评价。

senses.title: Productive of
senses.titleCN: 会产生……：正式搭配
senses.definition: in formal usage, followed by of to mean 'tending to bring about a stated result'
senses.definitionCN: 正式用法中后接 of，意为“容易带来所述结果”
senses.example: The policy proved productive of unexpected alliances.
senses.exampleCN: 这项政策促成了出人意料的联盟。
senses.why: The of construction states the output explicitly, which the bare adjective leaves implicit.
senses.whyCN: of 结构明确说出产物，而单用形容词时产物是隐含的。

senses.title: Productive skills
senses.titleCN: 语言教学：说和写
senses.definition: in language teaching, describing speaking and writing, the skills that produce language rather than receive it
senses.definitionCN: 语言教学中描述说与写，即产出语言而非接收语言的技能
senses.example: The course balances receptive and productive skills.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课程平衡接受性技能与产出性技能。
senses.why: Applied linguistics splits skills by direction. Productive skills send language out; receptive skills take it in.
senses.whyCN: 应用语言学按方向划分技能。产出性技能把语言送出去，接受性技能把语言收进来。

senses.title: Capacity for output
senses.titleCN: 生产能力：能出多少
senses.definition: describing the maximum output an economy, factory or system can generate
senses.definitionCN: 描述经济、工厂或系统能产生的最大产出
senses.example: The plant is running below its productive capacity.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂运转低于其生产能力。
senses.why: Capacity language turns the adjective into a ceiling: what could be led forth if everything worked.
senses.whyCN: 产能语言把这个形容词变成上限：一切顺利时能引出多少。

intro.en: Productive comes from Latin productivus 'fit for producing', from producere 'to lead forth' (pro- 'forward' + ducere 'to lead'), plus the English suffix -ive.
intro.cn: productive 来自拉丁 productivus“适于产出的”，源于 producere“向前引出”（pro-“向前”+ ducere“引导”），加英语后缀 -ive。

items.en: ducere 'to lead' is the base of a large family: conduct, reduce, introduce and educate each add a different prefix of direction.
items.cn: ducere“引导”是一大词族的基础：conduct、reduce、introduce、educate 各加不同方向的前缀。

items.en: pro- 'forward' plus ducere gives producere, 'to lead or bring forth'. The physical picture is leading something out.
items.cn: pro-“向前”加 ducere 构成 producere“引出、产生”。物理画面是把东西引出来。

items.en: Later Latin forms productivus on the participle stem product-, meaning 'having the power to produce'.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语在分词词干 product- 上构成 productivus，意为“有产出能力的”。

items.en: English adopts productive first for land and then for people, following the agricultural sense.
items.cn: 英语先把这个词用于土地，再用于人，顺着农业义延伸。

items.en: Clinical usage adds productive cough in the 19th century, where the thing produced is mucus.
items.cn: 19 世纪临床用法加入“有痰的咳嗽”，其中被产出之物是黏液。

items.en: In the 20th century productive capacity becomes an economic term, and productive skills a language-teaching term.
items.cn: 20 世纪，“生产能力”成为经济术语，“产出性技能”成为语言教学术语。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the duct- stem; the near-meaning group all imply good results, differing in what kind of result.
note.cn: 形近组共享 duct- 词干；近义组都暗含好结果，差别在结果种类。

entries.definition: output per unit of input. The noun is the ratio; the adjective describes the thing that yields.
entries.definitionCN: 生产率。名词是比率，形容词描述产出之物。

entries.definition: the item produced, or the result of a process. It is concrete output, not the ability to produce.
entries.definitionCN: 产品；结果。它是具体产出，不是生产能力。

entries.definition: relating to reasoning from general to specific. It shares ducere but uses de- 'down from', and means logic, not output.
entries.definitionCN: 演绎的。共享 ducere，但用 de-“从……向下”，指逻辑推理而非产出。

entries.definition: producing good results, often of discussion or effort. It is close to productive but more metaphorical.
entries.definitionCN: 富有成果的。接近 productive，但更具比喻色彩。

entries.definition: able to produce crops or young. It is the biological version, applied mainly to land and organisms.
entries.definitionCN: 肥沃的；能生育的。是生物学版本，主要用于土地与生物。

entries.definition: achieving results with little waste. It stresses the input side, while productive stresses the output side.
entries.definitionCN: 高效的。强调投入端，而 productive 强调产出端。

entries.definition: producing money. It is specifically financial, while productive may produce ideas, crops or goods.
entries.definitionCN: 赚钱的。专指金钱收益，而 productive 可产出想法、作物或货物。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词。

normal.en: The stem duct means 'lead', so productive is about what a thing leads forth.
normal.cn: 词干 duct 意为“引导”，所以 productive 关乎“引出什么”。

normal.en: Productive land, productive workers and productive meetings are three fields judged by the same output question.
normal.cn: 高产土地、高效工人、有成效的会议，三个领域都按同一“产出”问题评判。

normal.en: Productive cough is the literal use: the cough brings something up.
normal.cn: 有痰的咳嗽是字面用法：咳嗽把东西带出来。

normal.en: The pair productive skills and receptive skills splits language learning by direction.
normal.cn: 产出性技能与接受性技能按方向划分语言学习。

normal.en: Productive capacity is the ceiling; productivity is the ratio actually achieved.
normal.cn: 生产能力是上限，生产率是实际达到的比率。

abstract.en: Picture a tree so heavy with fruit that a branch touches the ground.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵果实累累、枝条垂到地面的树。

abstract.en: Picture a loom that turns thread into cloth faster than the eye can follow.
abstract.cn: 想象一台织机，把线变成布快得眼睛跟不上。

abstract.en: Picture a conversation that ends with a whiteboard full of arrows.
abstract.cn: 想象一场谈话结束时，白板上画满了箭头。

examples.en: The reform made the tax system more productive.
examples.cn: 这项改革让税收体系更有产出效率。

examples.en: They spent a productive afternoon drafting the plan.
examples.cn: 他们用了一个有成效的下午起草计划。

examples.en: The land here is productive enough to support two harvests.
examples.cn: 这里的土地足够高产，可以支持两季收成。

dict_mnemonic.text: “普若达克提夫”音近 productive：把东西“达”出来、克住懒散、提上产量——能出成果 → productive 多产的

root: 拉丁 pro-“向前”+ ducere“引导”→ producere“引出、产生”；product- 分词词干 + -ive（拉丁 -ivus，表能力）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all judge a thing by what it leads forth, whether crops, work, ideas, mucus or language.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都按“引出什么”来评判，无论引出的是作物、工作、想法、黏液还是语言。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a branch bent down by its own fruit.
core.cn: 核心意象：被自己的果实压弯的枝条。

branches.en: ORIGINAL IMAGE: results in general and crops from soil are the same leading-forth, one abstract and one physical.
branches.cn: 原始意象：一般成果与土地作物是同一种“引出”，一抽象一具体。

branches.en: HUMAN OUTPUT: a worker and a discussion are both judged by what they leave behind.
branches.cn: 人的产出：工人与讨论都按“留下了什么”来评判。

branches.en: MEDICINE: the cough literally produces something, which shows the literal core of the word.
branches.cn: 医学：咳嗽字面上产出了东西，显示了词的字面核心。

branches.en: FORMAL LINK: productive of states the result that the adjective otherwise implies.
branches.cn: 正式连接：productive of 明说结果，而单用形容词时结果是隐含的。

branches.en: DIRECTION AND CEILING: language skills split by output, and capacity names the maximum output.
branches.cn: 方向与上限：语言技能按输出划分，产能命名最大输出。

intro.en: Productive is the Latin stem product- plus -ive. The stem carries 'brought forth', and the suffix marks the capacity to do it.
intro.cn: productive 是拉丁词干 product- 加 -ive。词干携带“被引出”，后缀标记做这件事的能力。

latinIntro.en: Latin ducere 'lead' → producere 'bring forth' → productivus. English keeps duct- and adds -ive.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ducere“引导”→ producere“引出”→ productivus。英语保留 duct- 并加 -ive。

items.meaning: the act or amount of making

items.exampleCN: 他们这一天过得很有成效。
